name: HaloPad
game: Halo: Combat Evolved (Xbox) or Halo: Custom Edition (PC)
notes: HaloPad owns its release recipe. The updated source chooses Xbox-only from ISO/XISO, or both editions from the PC installer. Xbox-only skips Wine and PC translation; both editions need HaloCESetup.exe and product-key.txt. Xbox maps are imported in the app. Personal builds are never published.

commands: brew install cmake ninja lld llvm sdl3

game_data_import.ios: Choose Custom Edition, then Choose Prepared Package… (combined builds only)
game_data_import.macos: Choose Custom Edition, then Choose Prepared Package… (combined builds only)

steps: Install {file} on your iPhone or iPad, signed with your own Apple developer profile that allows Extended Virtual Addressing and Increased Memory Limit (the guide below shows how).
Updating? Install it over your current HaloPad with the same signing to keep your profiles and saves.

Open HaloPad to choose your edition. Xbox: choose Add Your Xbox Disc and select your own ISO/XISO (transfer it to Files on iPhone/iPad). If your build includes Custom Edition, copy Halo-CE.halopad.zip from the HaloPad game data folder in {folder}, choose Custom Edition and then Choose Prepared Package….
Unzip {file}, move HaloPad to your Applications folder and open it. It needs no Apple account.
Updating? Replace the old HaloPad in Applications; your profiles and saves stay.

Open HaloPad to choose your edition. Xbox: choose Add Your Xbox Disc and select your own ISO/XISO (transfer it to Files on iPhone/iPad). If your build includes Custom Edition, copy Halo-CE.halopad.zip from the HaloPad game data folder in {folder}, choose Custom Edition and then Choose Prepared Package….

off_mac.text: Build HaloPad's Xbox edition on GitHub's Mac with HaloPad's own build page: fork HaloPad, then run Actions → Build HaloPad (Xbox edition) in your fork. It makes an iPhone/iPad app and a Mac app, kept for 7 days. Add your own Xbox disc inside the app after installing. To sign it for iPhone or iPad, follow HaloPad's install guide: the app asks for extra memory capabilities, and a free Apple ID worked in one Xbox-edition iPad test but isn't tested more widely. Custom Edition, made from your own PC installer, needs an Apple Silicon Mac.

es.text: Crea la edición Xbox de HaloPad en el Mac de GitHub con la página de compilación de HaloPad: haz un fork de HaloPad y ejecuta Actions → Build HaloPad (Xbox edition) en tu fork. Crea una app para iPhone/iPad y una app para Mac, que se guardan 7 días. Añade tu propio disco de Xbox dentro de la app después de instalarla. Para firmarla en iPhone o iPad, sigue la guía de instalación de HaloPad: la app pide capacidades de memoria adicionales, y un Apple ID gratuito funcionó en una prueba de la edición Xbox en iPad, pero no se ha probado más. Custom Edition, creada con tu propio instalador de PC, necesita un Mac con Apple Silicon.

pt.text: Crie a edição Xbox do HaloPad no Mac do GitHub com a página de compilação do HaloPad: faça um fork do HaloPad e execute Actions → Build HaloPad (Xbox edition) no seu fork. Ela cria um app para iPhone/iPad e um app para Mac, guardados por 7 dias. Adicione seu próprio disco do Xbox dentro do app depois de instalar. Para assinar no iPhone ou iPad, siga o guia de instalação do HaloPad: o app pede capacidades extras de memória, e um Apple ID gratuito funcionou num teste da edição Xbox no iPad, mas ainda não foi testado mais amplamente. O Custom Edition, criado com o seu próprio instalador de PC, precisa de um Mac com Apple Silicon.
